texto.#education: BA (Hons) in Design, first-class honours. Postgraduate Diploma (specialisation) in Game Art. MA in Creative Industries, currently in progress. IELTS certified. Published work in the field.
texto.#experience: Senior 3D Character Artist at E-Line Media (Arizona, USA), almost five years, taking Endstar's hero characters from first sculpt to engine: sculpt, retopology, UVs, baking, PBR texturing, trim sheets, material work, look development and engine integration. Before that, The Wingfeather Saga season 1 at Angel Studios, where I modeled and hand-painted the characters, so the surface treatment was mine from block-in to final. Three years before that at PUGA Studios, delivering assets under another studio's art direction in the client's defined style. Tools: ZBrush, Substance Painter and Designer, Maya, Marmoset, Houdini for grooming, Unity and Unreal for integration. Portfolio holds 45+ projects with 60+ characters. I also founded and run my own character art school, which is where the mentoring and standard-setting side of senior work comes from.

perguntas.2467323: Olinda, Brazil (UTC-3, so a working day that overlaps London by a wide margin). I WANT TO RELOCATE and I am fully open to moving to London for the role.
perguntas.2467324: No. I am not a UK or EU citizen, so I would need visa sponsorship. Saying it plainly because I would rather you know now than later. For what it is worth on the visa side: first-class honours degree in Design, a postgraduate specialisation in Game Art, an MA in Creative Industries in progress, IELTS, published work, and more than ten years of senior production credits including The Wingfeather Saga season 1 and Endstar.
perguntas.2467326: Onsite or hybrid at the Oval studio, whichever the team prefers. I want to relocate to London for this role, so weekly in-studio time is not a compromise for me, it is the arrangement I would choose. Until relocation is done I can work fully remote with hours that overlap the team.
perguntas.2467327: Yes, and my answer is stronger than travel: I want to relocate to London. If the team prefers to start with travel, I am able and willing to be at the studio at whatever frequency helps, weekly included, and I would want to be there more at the start of a project rather than less.
perguntas.2467187: Around GBP 42,000 per year for the fixed-term salaried route, or the equivalent day rate if you go the contractor way. Open to aligning with your band for the role.
perguntas.2467186: Small team, short feedback loop, and a lead who stays hands-on. The work I am proudest of came from sitting close to the person setting the direction and iterating quickly instead of trading documents. I like owning a piece end to end and being trusted with it, and I like being reviewed honestly.
perguntas.2467185: Because the brief is the kind of work I would do anyway. Monument Valley, Alba and Desta are the reason I know ustwo games, and the description of the new project, painterly and colourful, sitting between realistic and stylised, with lighting, colour and materials doing the heavy lifting rather than dense geometry, describes how I already build. On The Wingfeather Saga season 1 I hand-painted the character surfaces, which is exactly that trade: shape language and colour carrying the read instead of polygon count. On Endstar at E-Line Media I have spent almost five years owning assets from sculpt to engine in Unity, including trim sheets, materials and look development, which is the technical lean towards shaders and materials you mention. I am a character artist by title and an asset artist by practice, and environment work is the half of the craft where composition and colour get to lead. Two honest notes, since you would find out anyway. Blender is the tool I have used least of the ones you list, and if it matters for collaborating directly in files with your Lead Artist, I would rather tell you now and get up to speed before day one than let it surprise either of us; my modelling and texturing craft is tool-independent and I have switched pipelines before. And I would need visa sponsorship. Everything else, the seniority, the full-pipeline ownership, the Unity experience and the taste for graphic design and illustration over traditional environment art, is already there.
